```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(vegan)
library(pheatmap)
library(dplyr)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(openxlsx)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)
library(ggplot2)
library(here)

run_name    <- params$run_name
output_dir  <- params$output_dir
prefix      <- paste0(run_name, "_")

dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

## Functional Heatmap (HUMAnN3 Pathways)

```{r func-heatmap, fig.width=12, fig.height=12}
# Pathway abundance file (CPM, rows = pathways, cols = samples)
pathway_file <- here("data", "pathway_abundance.xlsx")

if (file.exists(pathway_file)) {
  func_raw <- read.xlsx(pathway_file, sheet = "pathway_cpm", colNames = TRUE)

  func_mat <- as.matrix(func_raw[, -1])
  rownames(func_mat) <- func_raw[[1]]
  func_mat <- func_mat[!grepl("UNMAPPED|UNINTEGRATED", rownames(func_mat)), ]
  func_mat <- func_mat[, intersect(colnames(func_mat), metadata$SampleID),
                       drop = FALSE]

  # Log-transform CPM
  func_log <- log10(func_mat + 1)

  make_heatmap(func_mat, metadata[colnames(func_mat), ],
               title    = "Heatmap — MetaCyc Pathways (log10 CPM)",
               filename = "heatmap_pathway",
               width = 12, height = 14)

  # Export
  wb_func <- createWorkbook()
  addWorksheet(wb_func, "pathway_cpm")
  writeData(wb_func, "pathway_cpm",
            cbind(Pathway = rownames(func_mat), as.data.frame(func_mat)))
  saveWorkbook(wb_func,
               file.path(output_dir, paste0(prefix, "pathway_matrix.xlsx")),
               overwrite = TRUE)
} else {
  cat("Pathway file not found — skipping functional heatmap.\n")
}
```
